neighbours.label: HIV antiretroviral treatment and prevention: ART regimens, PrEP, treatment-naive patients, drug names such as tenofovir and dolutegravir; other antiviral therapies leak at about a third of the strength
fire: Dolutegravir-based regimens are now preferred for adults starting antiretroviral therapy in most national guidelines.
After six months on a tenofovir-lamivudine-dolutegravir combination, her HIV viral load was undetectable.
Long-acting injectable cabotegravir offers an alternative to daily oral PrEP for people at high risk of HIV.
The trial enrolled 600 treatment-naive adults with HIV-1 infection and randomised them to two integrase-inhibitor regimens.
Resistance to older non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors has forced many clinics to switch patients to newer HIV drugs.
Expanding access to antiretroviral drugs in sub-Saharan Africa turned HIV from a death sentence into a chronic condition.
Pregnant women living with HIV who stay on antiretroviral treatment almost never pass the virus to their babies.
Pharmacies in the city will now dispense PrEP without a prescription to reduce new HIV infections.
quiet: SGLT2-inhibitor regimens are now preferred for adults starting treatment for heart failure in most national guidelines.
After six months on a metformin-empagliflozin combination, her HbA1c was back in the normal range.
Long-acting injectable buprenorphine offers an alternative to daily oral doses for people recovering from opioid dependence.
The trial enrolled 600 newly diagnosed adults with rheumatoid arthritis and randomised them to two biologic regimens.
Resistance to older beta-lactam antibiotics has forced many hospitals to switch patients to carbapenems.
Expanding access to insulin in sub-Saharan Africa turned type 1 diabetes from a death sentence into a chronic condition.
Pregnant women with epilepsy who stay on their medication almost never have seizures during delivery.
Pharmacies in the city will now dispense statins without a prescription to reduce heart attacks.

notes: Probe: 'PrEP with emtricitabine and tenofovir' 1.236, 'first-line treatment for treatment-naive adults with HIV-1' 1.009, HAART/ART sentences 0.37-0.42. Insulin 0.202, metformin 0.244, chemotherapy 0.047, bakery 0.003. Direct-acting antivirals for hepatitis C 0.419: antiviral therapy in general leaks, so near misses here use non-viral conditions and the leak is noted. The + pole suppresses 'harm', 'stigma', 'needle' (drug-use harm reduction), the other side of the same clinical-HIV distinction.
